api.constructor: STTProviderEventBuffer(*, max_events: int = MAX_EVENTS, on_discard: Callable[[STTProviderTurnEvent, tuple[STTProviderTurnEvent, ...]], None] | None = None) -> None
api.callback: on_discard(discarded_event, retained_events) -> None; synchronous and optional
api.timing: Callbacks run after the complete admission/eviction decision. For closed-buffer puts the unchanged queue snapshot is passed before STTProviderEventBufferClosed is raised.
api.retained_events: Immutable tuple snapshot of final queued ownership, in delivery order, including the incoming event if accepted and any synthesized overflow terminal. Shared resources can therefore survive provisional replacement, room-making eviction, rejection and retirement.
api.notifications: Every rejected incoming event (including closed and retired-epoch puts) and every actually removed queued event is collected for disposal. Refused retirement does not report speculative removals. Successfully delivered events and healthy close/drain are not discarded.
api.errors: Owner callback exceptions propagate without suppression; the queue decision has already completed. A raising callback interrupts normal callback iteration.
api.speaker_independence: The buffer does not inspect tokens, resource stages or speaker policy. Owners decide disposal from the discarded event and retained references.
api.default_cost: No discard list or retained tuple is allocated when on_discard is None.

controlled_boundary.inline_driver:
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
archive = root / "build/issue264-validation-streaming-after-hidden-01/execution_sources.zip"
sys.path.insert(0, str(archive) + "/src")
import puripuly_heart.core.stt.backend
import puripuly_heart.core.stt

name = "puripuly_heart.core.stt.scoped_event_buffer"
source = root / "src/puripuly_heart/core/stt/scoped_event_buffer.py"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, source)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[name] = module
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
setattr(puripuly_heart.core.stt, "scoped_event_buffer", module)

import pytest
result = pytest.main([
    "--noconftest", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "-o", "pythonpath=",
    "-o", "addopts=", "-q", "-rA",
    "tests/core/test_stt_event_buffer_disposal.py",
])
inventory = []
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as frozen:
    for imported_name, imported in sorted(sys.modules.items()):
        if imported_name != "puripuly_heart" and not imported_name.startswith("puripuly_heart."):
            continue
        origin = getattr(imported, "__file__", None)
        if origin is None:
            raise RuntimeError("untracked product namespace: " + imported_name)
        normalized = origin.replace("\\", "/")
        if imported_name == name:
            assert Path(origin).resolve() == source.resolve()
            relative = source.relative_to(root).as_posix()
            payload = source.read_bytes()
            boundary = "current_owned_buffer"
        else:
            marker = "execution_sources.zip/"
            if marker not in normalized:
                raise RuntimeError("moving or untracked product import: " + imported_name + ": " + origin)
            relative = normalized.split(marker, 1)[1]
            payload = frozen.read(relative)
            boundary = "frozen_e4e85c_dependency"
        inventory.append({"module": imported_name, "path": relative, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(), "boundary": boundary})
print("ISSUE264_BUFFER_INVENTORY=" + json.dumps(inventory, sort_keys=True))
print("ISSUE264_BUFFER_TEST_EXIT=" + str(result))
raise SystemExit(result)
